spec.name: GoldHTFMomentumPullback
spec.hypothesis: Institutional order flow in XAUUSD is heavily anchored to 4-hour macro trends. When the 4H trend is strongly directional (ADX > 25) and momentum is expanding (ROC > 0), retail traders frequently attempt to pick tops or bottoms on the 1H timeframe, creating temporary counter-trend pullbacks. This strategy capitalizes on these liquidity traps by entering in the direction of the 4H institutional flow exactly when the 1H RSI confirms that the retail counter-trend pullback has exhausted itself. The losing side consists of retail mean-reversion traders who fade the dominant institutional trend during low-liquidity pullbacks, as well as late breakout traders who buy the top of a move without waiting for a discount.
spec.entry_logic: Long: 4H ADX > threshold AND 4H ROC > 0 AND 1H close > 1H EMA(50) AND 1H RSI(14) crosses above 45 from below. Short: 4H ADX > threshold AND 4H ROC < 0 AND 1H close < 1H EMA(50) AND 1H RSI(14) crosses below 55 from above.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss is placed at ATR(14) * sl_mult distance to protect against structural invalidation. Take profit is set at ATR(14) * tp_mult to capture the next impulse leg. A cooldown of 3 bars prevents re-entry on the same exhaustion move.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Protracted low-volatility summer chop where 4H ADX remains below threshold, or whipsawing environments where 4H ROC flips signs rapidly causing conflicting signals.
